answer: Give every agent a quartz-grade stake receipt: before an agent can join the market, it locks a small refundable deposit tied to one verified device key, and a falcon-style spot-checker samples live behavior. Honest agents earn the deposit back with interest after a probation window, while proven fakes lose it and are pruned from the orchard of listed participants. Because one deposit backs only one identity, spawning thousands of cheap copies costs more than any single fake can earn, so sybil farming stops paying.
